messages.subject: Simulate the source areas
parts:
Hello,
I need some help. I want to estimate the regions of origin for my dispersal events. Phylowiki mentions a way to simulate these areas by assigning probabilities or using multipliers, but I haven’t found a paper or document I could cite in my methodology regarding this approach. In Dupin et al. (2016), they calculate the areas of origin using multipliers modified by w, but since I didn’t estimate w and left it fixed, I’m not sure if I can use Dupin et al. (2016) as a reference. That’s why I want to know if there’s a paper that can help me with this or if I should use papers that discuss bioGeoBEARS in general.

Thank you so much!
